image_description: A close-up photograph of a single, large soap bubble floating against a soft-focus green background. The bubble is spherical and translucent, displaying distinct iridescent rainbow patterns (blues, pinks, greens) on its surface due to light interference. It reflects a distorted image of the surroundings, including what appears to be blue sky or foliage. Several out-of-focus bokeh circles are visible in the background, suggesting other bubbles or light sources.
